versions.matrix_arrow: arrow C data interface; catalog via pio_arrow_catalog_json
versions.diagnostic_wire: structured records: code, severity, message, id?, target?, suggested_action?, spans[], related[], details_json?

wasm32.features: default plus matrix on the facade; no C ABI, no gridfm parquet
wasm32.smoke: powerio/examples/wasm_smoke.rs: named in-memory bytes parse, typed narrowing, byte exact echo

semantics.element_identity: source element ids verbatim; uid row identity in stored documents
semantics.index_spaces: dense positions zero based at C and Python, one based in Julia select_state
semantics.dc_susceptance_sign: branch_susceptance is a positive Laplacian edge weight; flow p_branch = -b*(va_f - va_t) + b*shift
semantics.units: raw source units on parse; per unit and radians after to_normalized
semantics.diagnostics: stable dotted codes; branch on code, never message text; spans are byte ranges into retained sources
semantics.unsupported_capabilities: writers report fidelity losses as diagnostics instead of dropping silently

boundary_changes_since_previous: one parse family (pio_parse_file/str/bytes) returns PioModule for every value kind
PioNetwork renamed PioBalancedNetwork; PioDistNetwork renamed PioMulticonductorNetwork
errbuf calling convention replaced by PioError** with structured diagnostics
pio_string_free renamed pio_string_release; free verbs retired
pio_dist_* parse/convert family folded into the one parse and convert family
structured PioDiagnostics accessors added (len, code, severity, message, id, target, suggested_action, details_json, spans, related)
stored .pio.json is the version 1 module document; released 0.9 packages upgrade one way
